Name: CUTSCENE_GPARAM_WEATHER_PARAM_ST
Description: Picks the weather shown during a cutscene from the in-game weather at the moment it starts. Each column gives the weather to use in the cutscene for one in-game weather type.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Weather: Sunny
Fields.Description: Weather used in the cutscene when the in-game weather is Sunny.
